answer: Deposit + arbitration forfeiture. Before voting/grade, each identity must escrow 50 USDC through a registration wharf and pass a Yarrow PRNG challenge tied to that deposit; no vote/grade is accepted until the escrow is confirmed. A farm of 1000 clones pays 50,000 USDC and loses the full escrow when arbitration detects the shared-address reef (cluster) and forfeits all deposits. Honesty stays cheaper.
